column1: # CrowdStrike — Organization, Headcount & HR / Stock Compensation
# Source: SEC EDGAR — XBRL companyfacts (10-K, as reported) + cited 10-K text. USD unless noted.
# Headcount: 10,698 full-time employees as of January 31, 2026 (org chart by function: R&D, Sales & Marketing, Cost of Revenue/Cloud Ops, and G&A).
# Compensation model is equity-heavy: stock-based compensation is the single largest non-cash expense and the primary driver of GAAP operating losses (see EBITDA add-backs).
# Employee census: predominantly U.S.-based, with engineering hubs and international sales offices; no collective-bargaining agreements.
